author: pk11

conventions.K: 3 (a_0..a_3 plus the Lemma 19.1c remainder) where (D+1)^F < 9e18 at the entry's moment degree D (F <= 17 here); the float items (kt_s8f1_v1_2) print D
conventions.bonds: TM (3c, 3c+1), MB (3c+1, 3c+2) of column c; HT (3c, 3c+3), HM (3c+1, 3c+4), HB (3c+2, 3c+5) between columns c and c+1
conventions.classes: edges and pairs up to left-right (column c -> n-1-c, gap c -> n-2-c) and top-bottom (TM <-> MB, HT <-> HB, HM fixed) reflection; the key is the class representative, images lists the class
conventions.cov: J^2 Cov(sigma.sigma on e, sigma.sigma on f) = N_ef/Z - N_e N_f/Z^2, Z = S<n>,Z, N_e = S<n>,x,e, N_ef = S<n>,xy,e,f
conventions.flags: INFO: S0 (common vertex), L19.6a ((t_i, bb_i)), THM-n<=3 (Theorems D(i), B(a), C); every pair is certified anyway
conventions.keys: 'S<n>,Z' (graph pairs []), 'S<n>,x,c,B' (pairs [the bond]), 'S<n>,xy,c1,B1,c2,B2' (pairs [bond 1, bond 2]); one graph per key, F = V + number of pairs (V = 3n)
conventions.reuse: reuse_key: the class is S8's S4 entry of that key (S8_ENTRY_LIST_v2 4565c6c7, graph S4, pk03's D16 S4 records): not produced again
conventions.strip: whole strip, both ends free: verticals T-M 1, M-B 1 in every column, no T-B bond; horizontals 1 between adjacent columns (T-T, M-M, B-B); no vacuum column, no trial states (columns as S8_ENTRY_LIST_v2: free, int)
conventions.xi: [xi, B, c]: xi_uv = J(1 - sigma_u . sigma_v) on bond B at c, riglap3's xi factor: a vertical bond as S8, (xi, (3c, 3c+1, 3c+2), 0.0, c9 = e_TM or e_MB); a horizontal bond (u, v) as (xi, (u, v, v), 0.0, c9 = e_1), its (T, M) pair being (u, v) (only that pair is used; the factor's vertex set is {u, v})

purpose: P2-13 (C3-short; STB_PHASE2_PLAN_v1_6 row P2-13): every pair of distinct edges of P3 x P_n, n = 2..5, at N = 3 and 4, J >= 300 (t in [0, 1/300])
